name: wieferichK_eq_true_iff
statement: @[simp] theorem wieferichK_eq_true_iff (p : ℕ) (hp : p ≠ 1) : wieferichK p ↔ Wieferich p
proof:
:= by
  have hp2 : p ^ 2 ≠ 1 := by rwa [ne_eq, sq, mul_eq_one, and_self]
  rw [Wieferich, wieferichK, Nat.beq_eq, Nat.ModEq, Nat.one_mod_eq_one.mpr hp2,
    powModK_eq, Nat.pow_eq, Nat.sub_eq]

name: wieferichK_eq_false_iff
statement:
@[simp] theorem wieferichK_eq_false_iff (p : ℕ) (hp : p ≠ 1) :
    wieferichK p = false ↔ ¬Wieferich p
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Bool.not_eq_true, wieferichK_eq_true_iff p hp]

name: mirimanoffK_eq_true_iff
statement: @[simp] theorem mirimanoffK_eq_true_iff (p : ℕ) (hp : p ≠ 1) : mirimanoffK p ↔ Mirimanoff p
proof:
:= by
  have hp2 : p ^ 2 ≠ 1 := by rwa [ne_eq, sq, mul_eq_one, and_self]
  rw [Mirimanoff, mirimanoffK, Nat.beq_eq, Nat.ModEq, Nat.one_mod_eq_one.mpr hp2,
    powModK_eq, Nat.pow_eq, Nat.sub_eq]

name: mirimanoffK_eq_false_iff
statement:
@[simp] theorem mirimanoffK_eq_false_iff (p : ℕ) (hp : p ≠ 1) :
    mirimanoffK p = false ↔ ¬Mirimanoff p
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Bool.not_eq_true, mirimanoffK_eq_true_iff p hp]

name: wieferich_mirimanoff₁
statement:
theorem wieferich_mirimanoff₁ : ∀ n < 6000, n % 6 = 1 →
    (wieferichK n).not'.or' (mirimanoffK n).not'
proof:
:=
  forallB_of_mod _ (start := 1) (len := 1000) (step := 6) (by quickRfl)

name: wieferich₅
statement: theorem wieferich₅ : ∀ n < 6000, n % 6 = 5 → !wieferichK n
proof:
:=
  forallB_of_mod _ (start := 5) (len := 1000) (step := 6) (by quickRfl)

name: Nat.modEq_finset_prod_iff
statement:
theorem Nat.modEq_finset_prod_iff {a b : ℕ} {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (e : ι → ℕ)
    (co : (s : Set ι).Pairwise (Coprime.onFun e)) :
    a ≡ b [MOD ∏ i ∈ s, e i] ↔ ∀ i ∈ s, a ≡ b [MOD e i]
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨l, hl, rfl⟩ := s.exists_list_nodup_eq
  rw [List.prod_toFinset e hl, Nat.modEq_list_map_prod_iff]
  · simp_rw [List.mem_toFinset]
  · rwa [← List.pairwise_iff_coe_toFinset_pairwise hl]

name: PrimeCert.forallB_zero
statement:
@[simp, grind =] theorem forallB_zero (f : ℕ → Bool) (start step : ℕ) :
    forallB f start 0 step = true
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: PrimeCert.forallB_succ
statement:
@[simp, grind =] theorem forallB_succ (f : ℕ → Bool) (start len step : ℕ) :
    forallB f start (len + 1) step =
      (f ((len.mul step).add start)).and' (forallB f start len step)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: PocklingtonPred.zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem PocklingtonPred.zero {N root : ℕ} :
    PocklingtonPred N root 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [PocklingtonPred]

name: Nat.modEq_iff_exists_mul_add'
statement:
theorem Nat.modEq_iff_exists_mul_add' {p q b : ℕ} (hqp : q ≤ p) :
    p ≡ q [MOD b] ↔ ∃ k, k * b + q = p
proof:
:= by
  rw [ModEq.comm, modEq_iff_dvd' hqp]
  rw [le_iff_exists_add'] at hqp
  obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := hqp
  simp_rw [add_tsub_cancel_right, add_left_inj, dvd_iff_exists_eq_mul_left, eq_comm]

name: PrimeCert.pocklington3_test
statement:
theorem pocklington3_test (N F R m r s : ℕ)
    (R_def : F * R + 1 = N) (r_def : R % (2 * F) = r) (s_def : R / (2 * F) = s)
    (h2n : 2 ≤ N) (odd_n : Odd N) (odd_R : Odd R)
    (primitive : ∀ p ∈ F.primeFactors, ∃ a, a ^ (N - 1) ≡ 1 [MOD N] ∧
      (a ^ ((N - 1) / p) - 1).gcd N = 1)
    (divisors : ∀ l, 1 ≤ l → l < m → ¬ l * F + 1 ∣ N)
    (bound : N + (m * F + 1) * (m * F) < (m * F + 1) * (2 * F ^ 2 + r * F + 1))
    (cert : s = 0 ∨ ¬ IsSquare (r ^ 2 - 8 * s) ∨ r ^ 2 < 8 * s) :
    Nat.Prime N
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [Nat.prime_iff_not_exists_mul_eq', not_exists, not_and]
  refine ⟨by lia, fun p q h2p hpn h2q hqn hpq ↦ ?_⟩
  have := pocklington_test N F (by lia)
    (by rw [← R_def, Nat.add_sub_cancel_right]; exact dvd_mul_right _ _) primitive
  replace this := Nat.modEq_one_of_dvd_of_prime _ _ this
  have hp := this p (hpq ▸ dvd_mul_right _ _)
  have hq := this q (hpq ▸ dvd_mul_left _ _)
  rw [Nat.modEq_iff_exists_mul_add' (by lia)] at hp hq
  obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := hp
  obtain ⟨d, rfl⟩ := hq
  have hmc : m ≤ c := le_of_not_gt fun hcm ↦ by
    obtain hc | hc := le_or_gt 1 c
    · exact divisors c hc hcm (hpq ▸ dvd_mul_right _ _)
    · interval_cases c; rw [zero_mul] at h2p; lia
  have hmd : m ≤ d := le_of_not_gt fun hdm ↦ by
    obtain hd | hd := le_or_gt 1 d
    · exact divisors d hd hdm (hpq ▸ dvd_mul_left _ _)
    · interval_cases d; rw [zero_mul] at h2q; lia
  have hf₀ : F ≠ 0 := by rintro rfl; rw [zero_mul] at R_def; lia
  have hR₂ := Nat.div_add_mod R (2 * F)
  rw [r_def, s_def] at hR₂
  rw [show (c * F + 1) * (d * F + 1) = F * ((c * d) * F + (c + d)) + 1 by ring,
    ← R_def, add_left_inj, Nat.mul_right_inj hf₀] at hpq
  have even_F : Even F := by
    rw [← R_def, Nat.odd_add_one, Nat.not_odd_iff_even, Nat.even_mul] at odd_n
    exact odd_n.resolve_right (Nat.not_even_iff_odd.mpr odd_R)
  have odd_cd : Odd (c + d) := by
    rw [← hpq] at odd_R
    refine (Nat.odd_add'.mp odd_R).mpr <| Even.mul_left even_F _
  have even_cd : Even (c * d) := by
    rw [Nat.odd_add, ← Nat.not_even_iff_odd] at odd_cd
    rw [Nat.even_mul]; exact (em (Even c)).imp id odd_cd.mp
  have hcdr : (c + d) % (2 * F) = r := by
    obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := even_iff_exists_two_mul.mp even_cd
    replace hpq := congr($hpq % (2 * F))
    rwa [hq, mul_right_comm, Nat.mul_add_mod, r_def] at hpq
  have hcdm : (c + d) * m ≤ c * d + m ^ 2 := by
    rw [add_mul]
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := le_iff_exists_add.mp hmc
    obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := le_iff_exists_add.mp hmd
    rw [hc, hd]
    lia
  have hcdr₁ : c + d < 2 * F + r := by
    rw [← R_def, ← hpq] at bound
    conv_lhs at bound => exact
      show _ = (c * d + m ^ 2) * F ^ 2 + (c + d) * F + (m * F + 1) by ring
    grw [← hcdm] at bound
    conv_lhs at bound => exact show _ = (m * F + 1) * ((c + d) * F + 1) by ring
    rw [mul_lt_mul_iff_right₀ (by lia), add_lt_add_iff_right] at bound
    conv_rhs at bound => exact show _ = (2 * F + r) * F by ring
    rwa [mul_lt_mul_iff_left₀ (by lia)] at bound
  have hcdr₂ := Nat.div_add_mod (c + d) (2 * F)
  rw [hcdr] at hcdr₂
  rw [← hcdr₂, add_lt_add_iff_right, mul_lt_iff_lt_one_right (by lia), Nat.lt_one_iff] at hcdr₁
  rw [hcdr₁, mul_zero, zero_add] at hcdr₂
  have hscd := hR₂.trans hpq.symm
  rw [← hcdr₂, add_left_inj, mul_right_comm, mul_left_inj' (by lia)] at hscd
  obtain cert | cert := cert
  · 
    rw [cert, mul_zero, eq_comm, mul_eq_zero] at hscd
    lia
  · 
    have square : r ^ 2 = 8 * s + (max c d - min c d) ^ 2 := by
      rw [hcdr₂, show 8 = 4 * 2 by rfl, mul_assoc, hscd, Nat.add_sq_eq_dist_sq_add_four_mul,
        add_comm]
    rw [square, Nat.add_sub_cancel_left] at cert
    obtain cert | cert := cert
    · exact cert ⟨_, sq _⟩
    · lia

name: PrimeCert.Pocklington3Cert.of_prime
statement:
theorem Pocklington3Cert.of_prime (r s p : Nat) (hp : Nat.Prime p) (h2p : 2 < p)
    (cond : (r ^ 2 - 8 * s) ^ (p / 2) % p = p - 1) :
    Pocklington3Cert r s
proof:
:= by
  refine .inr <| .inl fun h ↦ ?_
  have p_odd : p % 2 = 1 := by rw [← Nat.not_even_iff, Nat.Prime.even_iff hp]; lia
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := h
  rw [ha, ← sq, ← pow_mul, Nat.two_mul_odd_div_two p_odd] at cond
  replace cond := congr(($cond : ZMod p))
  have := Fact.mk hp
  rw [ZMod.natCast_mod, Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_sub hp.one_le, ZMod.natCast_self, zero_sub,
    Nat.cast_one] at cond
  have ha : (a : ZMod p) ≠ 0 := by
    rintro ha; rw [ha, zero_pow (by lia), eq_comm, neg_eq_zero] at cond; grind
  rw [ZMod.pow_card_sub_one_eq_one ha, eq_neg_iff_add_eq_zero, one_add_one_eq_two, ← Nat.cast_two,
    ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff] at cond
  exact not_lt_of_ge (Nat.le_of_dvd (by lia) cond) h2p

name: PrimeCert.Pocklington3CertMode.to_cert
statement:
theorem Pocklington3CertMode.to_cert (m : Pocklington3CertMode) (r s : ℕ) (h : m.calculate r s) :
    Pocklington3Cert r s
proof:
:= by
  cases m with
  | zero => exact .inl <| Nat.beq_eq.to_iff.mp h
  | prime p hp =>
    simp only [calculate, Nat.pow_eq, Nat.mul_eq, Nat.sub_eq, Nat.div_eq_div, Nat.pred_eq_sub_one,
      Bool.and_eq_true, Nat.blt_eq, Nat.beq_eq, mul_comm s, powModK_eq] at h
    exact .of_prime _ _ p hp h.1 h.2
  | lt => exact .inr <| .inr <| Nat.blt_eq.to_iff.mp <| mul_comm 8 s ▸ h

name: PrimeCert.PrimePow.toNat_def
statement: @[simp] theorem PrimePow.toNat_def (pp : PrimePow) : pp.toNat = pp.prime ^ pp.pow
proof: := rfl

name: PrimeCert.PrimePow.prime_dvd_toNat
statement: theorem PrimePow.prime_dvd_toNat (pp : PrimePow) : pp.prime ∣ pp.toNat
proof:
:=
  dvd_pow_self _ <| ne_of_gt <| Nat.blt_eq.to_iff.mp pp.pow_ne_zero

name: PrimeCert.mem_primeFactors_prod_toNat
statement:
theorem mem_primeFactors_prod_toNat (L : List PrimePow) (p : ℕ) :
    p ∈ (L.map PrimePow.toNat |>.prod |>.primeFactors) → ∃ pp ∈ L, pp.prime = p
proof:
:= by
  induction L with
  | nil => simp
  | cons pp _ ih =>
    rw [List.map_cons, List.prod_cons, Nat.primeFactors_mul, List.exists_mem_cons_iff,
      Finset.mem_union, pp.toNat_def]
    · refine Or.imp ?_ ih
      · by_cases h0 : pp.pow = 0
        · rw [h0, pow_zero, Nat.primeFactors_one]; grind
        · rw [Nat.primeFactors_prime_pow h0 pp.pf]; grind
    · exact pow_ne_zero _ pp.pf.ne_zero
    · refine List.prod_ne_zero ?_
      rw [List.mem_map, not_exists]
      exact fun pp h ↦ absurd h.2 <| pow_ne_zero _ pp.pf.ne_zero

name: PrimeCert.of_gcd_pred_mod_eq_one
statement:
theorem of_gcd_pred_mod_eq_one (a b : ℕ) (h : (a % b - 1).gcd b = 1)
    (hb : 2 ≤ b) : (a - 1).gcd b = 1
proof:
:= by
  rwa [Nat.gcd_comm, Nat.gcd_def, if_neg (by omega), ← Nat.mod_sub_of_le]
  · by_cases h₀ : a % b = 0
    · rw [h₀, Nat.zero_sub, Nat.gcd_zero_left] at h; omega
    · omega

name: powModK_aux_zero_eq
statement:
@[simp] lemma powModK_aux_zero_eq {n a b c : ℕ} :
    powModK.aux n 0 a b c = 0
proof: := rfl

name: powModK_aux_succ_eq
statement:
lemma powModK_aux_succ_eq {n a b c fuel : ℕ} :
    powModK.aux n (fuel + 1) a b c =
      (b.beq 0).rec (true := c % n)
      (((b % 2).beq 0).rec
        (powModK.aux n fuel (a * a % n) (b / 2) (a * c % n))
        (powModK.aux n fuel (a * a % n) (b / 2) c))
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: powModK_aux_succ_eq'
statement:
lemma powModK_aux_succ_eq' {n a b c fuel : ℕ} :
    powModK.aux n (fuel + 1) a b c =
      if b = 0 then c % n else
      if b % 2 = 0 then powModK.aux n fuel (a * a % n) (b / 2) c
      else powModK.aux n fuel (a * a % n) (b / 2) (a * c % n)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [powModK_aux_succ_eq, Bool.rec_eq, beq_eq]

name: powModK_aux_eq
statement:
lemma powModK_aux_eq (n a b c fuel) (hfuel : b < fuel) :
    powModK.aux n fuel a b c = powModAux a b c n
proof:
:= by
  induction fuel generalizing a b c with
  | zero => omega
  | succ fuel ih =>
    rw [powModK_aux_succ_eq']
    split
    case isTrue hb0 => rw [hb0, powModAux, pow_zero, one_mul]
    split
    case isTrue hb0 hbe =>
      rw [ih _ _ _ (by omega)]
      rw [powModAux, powModAux, Nat.mul_mod _ c, Nat.mul_mod _ c]
      conv_rhs =>
        rw [← Nat.mod_add_div b 2]
      rw [hbe, zero_add, pow_mul, ← pow_two, ← Nat.pow_mod]
    case isFalse hb0 hbo =>
      rw [ih _ _ _ (by omega)]
      rw [powModAux, powModAux, Nat.mul_mod, Nat.mod_mod, ← pow_two,
        ← Nat.pow_mod, ← Nat.pow_mul, ← Nat.mul_mod, ← mul_assoc, ← Nat.pow_add_one]
      congr! 3
      lia

name: PrimeCert.Sieve.initK_eq
statement: lemma initK_eq {M : ℕ} : initK M = (2 ^ M - 1) <<< 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [initK, Nat.shiftLeft_eq]
  grind

name: PrimeCert.Sieve.testBit_initK
statement:
theorem testBit_initK {M t : ℕ} :
    (initK M).testBit t ↔ 1 ≤ t ∧ t ≤ M
proof: := by grind [initK_eq]

name: PrimeCert.Sieve.coprime6_mod
statement:
@[grind =]
theorem coprime6_mod {m : ℕ} : m.Coprime 6 ↔ m % 6 = 1 ∨ m % 6 = 5
proof:
:= by
  have : ∀ t < 6, t.gcd 6 = 1 ↔ t % 6 = 1 ∨ t % 6 = 5 := by decide
  simpa using this (m % 6) (Nat.mod_lt _ (by simp))

name: PrimeCert.Sieve.value_add_two_mul
statement:
@[grind =]
theorem value_add_two_mul {k m : ℕ} : value (k + 2 * m) = value k + 6 * m
proof: := by grind [value]

name: PrimeCert.Sieve.le_index_of_value_le
statement: theorem le_index_of_value_le {n t : ℕ} (h : value t ≤ n) : t ≤ index n
proof: := by grind [value, index]

name: PrimeCert.Sieve.value_startA
statement:
@[grind =]
theorem value_startA {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Coprime 6) : value (index (p * 5)) = 5 * p
proof:
:= by
  grind [Nat.coprime_mul_iff_left]

name: PrimeCert.Sieve.value_startB
statement:
@[grind =]
theorem value_startB {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Coprime 6) : value (index (p * 7)) = 7 * p
proof:
:= by
  grind [Nat.coprime_mul_iff_left]

name: PrimeCert.Sieve.buildMaskK_zero
statement:
@[simp, grind =] theorem buildMaskK_zero {p M A B : ℕ} :
    buildMaskK p M A B 0 = 1 <<< A ||| 1 <<< B
proof: := rfl

name: PrimeCert.Sieve.buildMaskK_succ_raw
statement:
theorem buildMaskK_succ_raw {p M A B n : ℕ} :
    buildMaskK p M A B (n + 1)
      = Bool.rec (buildMaskK p M A B n)
          ((buildMaskK p M A B n).lor
            ((buildMaskK p M A B n).shiftLeft (p.shiftLeft n.succ)))
          ((p.shiftLeft n.succ).ble M)
proof: := rfl

name: PrimeCert.Sieve.buildMaskK_succ
statement:
theorem buildMaskK_succ {p M A B n : ℕ} :
    buildMaskK p M A B (n + 1)
      = if p * 2 ^ (n + 1) ≤ M
        then buildMaskK p M A B n ||| buildMaskK p M A B n <<< (p * 2 ^ (n + 1))
        else buildMaskK p M A B n
proof:
:= by
  have hs : p <<< (n + 1) = p * 2 ^ (n + 1) := by grind [Nat.shiftLeft_eq]
  simp [buildMaskK_succ_raw, hs, Bool.rec_eq]

name: PrimeCert.Sieve.testBit_buildMaskK_pow
statement:
theorem testBit_buildMaskK_pow {p M A B n t : ℕ} (ht : t ≤ M) :
    (buildMaskK p M A B n).testBit t ↔ (∃ j < 2 ^ n, t = A + 2 * p * j ∨ t = B + 2 * p * j)
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing t with
  | zero => grind [one_shiftLeft]
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [buildMaskK_succ]
    have h : 2 ^ (n + 1) = 2 ^ n + 2 ^ n := by grind
    obtain hg | hg := le_or_gt (p * 2 ^ (n + 1)) M
    · rw [if_pos hg, Nat.testBit_or, Nat.testBit_shiftLeft]
      simp only [ge_iff_le, Bool.or_eq_true, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq]
      rw [ih (by lia), ih (by lia), h, exists_lt_add_iff_lt_left, ← exists_and_left]
      congr! 1
      apply exists_congr (by grind)
    · rw [if_neg hg.not_ge, ih ht, h, exists_lt_add_iff_lt_left, iff_self_or]
      grind [mul_add]

name: PrimeCert.Sieve.prog_iff_dvd
statement:
theorem prog_iff_dvd {c t p B : ℕ} (hB : t < 2 * p * B) :
    (∃ j < B, t = c + 2 * p * j) ↔ (c ≤ t ∧ 2 * p ∣ t - c)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨Nat.le_add_right _ _, ⟨j, by lia⟩⟩
  · rintro ⟨hc, k, hk⟩
    refine ⟨k, ?_, by lia⟩
    have hlt : 2 * p * k < 2 * p * B := by lia
    exact Nat.lt_of_mul_lt_mul_left hlt

name: PrimeCert.Sieve.testBit_buildMaskK
statement:
theorem testBit_buildMaskK {p M A B n t : ℕ} (hp : p ≠ 0) (ht : t ≤ M) (hM : M < 2 ^ n) :
    (buildMaskK p M A B n).testBit t ↔
      (A ≤ t ∧ 2 * p ∣ t - A) ∨ (B ≤ t ∧ 2 * p ∣ t - B)
proof:
:= by
  have : t < 2 * p * 2 ^ n := by
    grw [ht, hM]
    exact Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left _ (by positivity)
  simp_rw [← prog_iff_dvd this, ← exists_or, testBit_buildMaskK_pow ht, and_or_left]

name: PrimeCert.Sieve.mask_iff
statement:
theorem mask_iff {p M t : ℕ} (hp6 : p.Coprime 6)
    (hM : M < 2 ^ 32) (ht : t ≤ M) :
    (buildMaskK p M (index (p * 5)) (index (p * 7)) 32).testBit t ↔
      ∃ k, 5 ≤ k ∧ k.Coprime 6 ∧ value t = p * k
proof:
:= by
  rw [testBit_buildMaskK (by grind) ht hM]
  constructor
  · rintro (⟨hle, c, hc⟩ | ⟨hle, c, hc⟩)
    · exact ⟨5 + 6 * c, by lia, coprime6_mod.2 (by lia), by grind [value, index]⟩
    · exact ⟨7 + 6 * c, by lia, coprime6_mod.2 (by lia), by grind [value, index]⟩
  · rintro ⟨k, hk5, hk6, hval⟩
    rcases coprime6_mod.1 hk6 with h1 | h5
    · right
      obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ : ∃ j, k = 7 + 6 * j := ⟨(k - 7) / 6, by grind⟩
      have ht2 : value t = value (index (p * 7) + 2 * (p * j)) := by grind
      exact ⟨by grind, j, by grind⟩
    · left
      obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ : ∃ j, k = 5 + 6 * j := ⟨(k - 5) / 6, by grind⟩
      have ht2 : value t = value (index (p * 5) + 2 * (p * j)) := by grind
      exact ⟨by grind, j, by grind⟩

name: PrimeCert.Sieve.markMaskK_eq_ldiff
statement:
theorem markMaskK_eq_ldiff {bits p M : ℕ} :
    markMaskK bits p M = bits.ldiff (buildMaskK p M (index (p * 5)) (index (p * 7)) 32)
proof:
:= by
  rw [markMaskK]
  simp [sub_and_eq_ldiff]

name: PrimeCert.Sieve.testBit_markMaskK
statement:
theorem testBit_markMaskK {bits p M t : ℕ} :
    (markMaskK bits p M).testBit t
      = (bits.testBit t && !(buildMaskK p M (index (p * 5)) (index (p * 7)) 32).testBit t)
proof:
:= by
  rw [markMaskK_eq_ldiff, Nat.testBit_ldiff]

name: PrimeCert.Sieve.sieveLoopK_succ_eq_ite
statement:
theorem sieveLoopK_succ_eq_ite {M bits start fuel : ℕ} :
    sieveLoopK M bits start (fuel + 1)
      = if (sieveLoopK M bits start fuel).testBit (start + fuel)
        then markMaskK (sieveLoopK M bits start fuel) (value (start + fuel)) M
        else sieveLoopK M bits start fuel
proof:
:= by
  grind [sieveLoopK_succ, Bool.rec_eq]

name: PrimeCert.Sieve.markMaskK_preserves_prime
statement:
theorem markMaskK_preserves_prime {b p M t : ℕ} (hp6 : p.Coprime 6) (hp5 : 5 ≤ p)
    (hM : M < 2 ^ 32) (ht : t ≤ M) (hprime : (value t).Prime) :
    (markMaskK b p M).testBit t = b.testBit t
proof:
:= by
  rw [testBit_markMaskK]
  suffices h : (buildMaskK p M (index (p * 5)) (index (p * 7)) 32).testBit t = false by simp [h]
  by_contra hc
  rw [Bool.not_eq_false, mask_iff hp6 hM ht] at hc
  obtain ⟨k, hk5, _, hval⟩ := hc
  rcases hprime.eq_one_or_self_of_dvd p ⟨k, hval⟩ with rfl | hself
  · lia
  · have : 1 = k := Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left (n := p) (by lia) (by lia)
    lia

name: PrimeCert.Sieve.sieveLoopK_preserves
statement:
theorem sieveLoopK_preserves {M bits start fuel t : ℕ} (hstart : start ≠ 0)
    (hM : M < 2 ^ 32) (ht : t ≤ M) (hprime : (value t).Prime) :
    (sieveLoopK M bits start fuel).testBit t = bits.testBit t
proof:
:= by
  induction fuel with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ f ih =>
    rw [sieveLoopK_succ_eq_ite]
    split
    · rw [markMaskK_preserves_prime (value_coprime6 _) (five_le_value (by grind)) hM ht hprime, ih]
    · exact ih

name: PrimeCert.Sieve.sieve_prime_set
statement:
theorem sieve_prime_set {n sN t : ℕ} (ht1 : t ≠ 0) (htM : t ≤ index n) (hM : index n < 2 ^ 32)
    (hprime : (value t).Prime) :
    (sieveK n sN).testBit t = true
proof:
:= by
  grind [sieveK, index, div_eq_div, sieveLoopK_preserves, testBit_initK]

name: PrimeCert.Sieve.sieveLoopK_clears
statement:
theorem sieveLoopK_clears {M start t j m : ℕ} (hstart : start ≠ 0)
    (hM : M < 2 ^ 32) (ht : t ≤ M) (hjprime : (value j).Prime) (hjt : j ≤ t)
    (hm5 : 5 ≤ m) (hm6 : m.Coprime 6) (hval : value t = value j * m) (hj_lo : start ≤ j)
    {fuel : ℕ} (hfuel : j < start + fuel) :
    (sieveLoopK M (initK M) start fuel).testBit t = false
proof:
:= by
  induction fuel with
  | zero => lia
  | succ f ih =>
    rw [sieveLoopK_succ_eq_ite]
    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge j (start + f) with hlt | hge
    · split <;> simp [testBit_markMaskK, ih hlt]
    · have hset : (sieveLoopK M (initK M) start f).testBit (start + f) = true := by
        rw [sieveLoopK_preserves hstart hM (by lia) (by grind)]
        grind [testBit_initK]
      simp_rw [if_pos hset, testBit_markMaskK, Bool.and_eq_false_iff, Bool.not_eq_eq_eq_not,
        Bool.not_false]
      rw [mask_iff (value_coprime6 _) hM ht]
      exact Or.inr ⟨m, by grind⟩

name: PrimeCert.Sieve.markMaskK_le
statement: theorem markMaskK_le {bits p M : ℕ} : markMaskK bits p M ≤ bits
proof:
:= by
  grind [markMaskK_eq_ldiff, Nat.and_add_ldiff]

name: PrimeCert.Sieve.sieveLoopK_le
statement: theorem sieveLoopK_le {M bits start fuel : ℕ} : sieveLoopK M bits start fuel ≤ bits
proof:
:= by
  induction fuel with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ f ih => grind [sieveLoopK_succ_eq_ite]
